reviews.text:
They do decent grooming work, but on my last visit I felt overcharged. My normal grooming price was always between $140. to $ 160. plus a tip. When i picked up my dog, the price seemed to arbitrarily jump to $180. and was made to feel that the higher pricing was arbitrary due to what was called a matted hair add on fee of $20. which was set at the discretion of the groomer. (after-all they just cut the matted area out).(that's what the tip is for).
When i questioned the cost, the base price as well as the addition fees kept changing between three staff members, one of which I always assumed was the owner. Anyway it seemed very unprofessional and I was very uncomfortable with the situation and I felt overcharged and dis-respected as a returning customer.

For first time ever taking my dog to any dog grooming salon. They did the best job. I love their attention, care, and especially patience. My dog is a old chihuahua with anxious personality. They handle it well, and my dog is now a fluffy, soft, and cuter than ever. Great place and affordable!

I have nothing but good things to say about Sally's! My dog is very anxious at the groomers, but I let them know that up front and they were able to make adjustments to accommodate. They even let me bring him back for a quick follow up to groom the areas they couldn't get the first time. The feedback they provided was also very helpful. It's obviously not their job to manage my dogs anxiety - that's my responsibility as the pet owner. Now my dog takes a mild anti anxiety med before each appointment and does fantastic! They make sure to never push past his limits, which I truly appreciate.

They are all such nice people and I trust that my dog is safe when he's there. I would definitely recommend Sally's to friends.
Fabulous groomer,  extremely professional and takes very good care of my nervous pomeranian! Love his cut!
Both dogs always come home looking amazing 👍

Sally's is the best! We have been taking our dog Deon there now for close to a year and they never disappoint! Everyone is super accommodating, and Deon always comes back so fresh!

I've referred 2 of my friends here and they both love Sally's too!

My little guy has VERY sensitive skin and this is the first haircut he’s received that he didn’t develop an itchy rash on his tummy from the clippers. They took amazing care of my boy and was so gentle. I couldn’t recommend this place enough especially for owners who have dogs with skin conditions/allergies. Not to mention they give the cutest haircuts. Thank you so much for taking great care of Louie!!

Sally's Paw Spaw located on Passyunk Ave has great staff members that provide high quality service to animals. The pricing is reasonable. The service provided was quick and accurate. Keep up the good work 👍 -Good Luck in 2026 & Beyond.

We were recommended this spa because of its high ratings and multiple reviews claiming they work well with anxious dogs. Unfortunately, our experience was the complete opposite.

We gave this place three chances, and every visit was disappointing. The first two times, my dog left looking like he barely received a haircut at all, yet I was charged $115 each time (not including gratuity). There was little to no noticeable grooming done, which was frustrating but we decided to give them one last try.

For the third visit, I specifically requested a buzz cut since the previous cuts clearly weren’t sufficient for my dog’s maintenance needs. About two hours into the appointment, I received a call saying my dog was “highly anxious” and that they could not finish the groom. When I arrived, I was shocked—only two of his legs had been cut, poorly, and my dog was visibly distressed.

Despite barely grooming him at all, they still attempted to charge me half the price of a full groom and suggested that I medicate my dog with anxiety medication before returning. For a business that has many reviews on being skilled with anxious dogs, this is unacceptable and irresponsible.

Between the excessive pricing, lack of results, and how this situation was handled, I will never return and would strongly caution others—especially those with anxious pets—to look elsewhere.

We found Sally’s Paw after meeting some of their staff at a restaurant—everyone was so friendly and clearly enjoyed working together. Our previous groomer retired, so we gave Sally’s a try and it’s been fantastic. Benji is amazing with our pup, Lucy—so kind and gentle every time. Highly recommend Sally’s Paw: locally owned, super affordable, and well worth it.

First time bringing my Rocky here..I'm am so pleased..Rocky felt so comfortable and he looks and feels amazing..im would recommend u ladies highly to anyone..thank u for taking care of my furbaby..he went to Rainbow Bridge Oct 20th.2025🐾💔 …

We’ve been working with Benji for a couple of months now and while the grooming has been excellent I’ve really appreciated her patience and positive attitude with my puppy Phoebe. Phoebe can be a little anxious but Benji’s willingness to work with her has been reassuring, and her flexibility in “tweaking” her cuts to find the best fit for Phoebe and I’s lifestyle has also been great. Thank you Benji! ☺️🐶
Absolutely loved it and Harley looked amazing the 1st she went here and now we’re going again this week

This was our first time at a groomer and we had the best experience! Our dog is a 5 month old puppy and she was treated so well during her visit. Sally’s creates a calm, safe, and fun environment for the dogs in their care. We will definitely be back! 💕 …

Wow. Sally’s is the place to go! Everyone I spoke to was welcoming, friendly, and super helpful with figuring out the haircut that was best for my dog! Specifically, Jo took great care of my young dog that is newer to grooming still. Will absolutely be back!
Max looks so handsome after being groomed. The groomer did an excellent job.  The owner was very polite and professional.

Best dog grooming experience Pancake had had in a couple of years! From start to finish, things went great. Pancake immediately made friends with the other dogs when we walked in.  His nails were perfectly trimmed. Others have over-trimmed his black nails, which wrecks his trust. And they gave him the cutest bandana! Finally, he smelled good for days!

2025 update: still love Sally! Highly recommend

We've been bringing our dog here since moving to Philly and I wouldn't go anywhere else. Sally takes fantastic care of our dog while he's with her and he comes back looking healthy and happy!
I have never seen so many happy faces while they say how cute Pierre looks.
Great doggie spa we wouldn’t trust our four legged kids with just anybody.  Fantastic experience the first time, they will be our groomers as long as we’re in Philly, barring the unforeseen.

Sally and her team are the best! They get to know and take care of each dog as if it’s their own, and they provide a welcoming, open environment that helps dogs feel at ease. Sally’s is the perfect spot to make sure your pup feels loved and pampered during their grooming experience.

I had a wonderful experience at Sally’s Paw Spa! Benji took the time to thoroughly review my grooming preferences before the appointment, ensuring everything was perfect. The staff was incredibly kind, and my Golden Retriever was comfortable throughout the process. When I picked him up, he was relaxed and waiting. He looked absolutely beautiful—I had forgotten what he was supposed to look like! Lol. Highly recommend Sally’s Paw Spa for anyone looking for a caring and professional grooming service!
Our dog Lando loves coming to Sally's and comes home so clean and happy! Highly recommend!

Sally is the best! She does a great job and is so kind and accommodating of my senior dog’s injury while clipping his nails. I will only go to Sally for my dog’s nails and plan to bring him next time for a full bath :)
Sally is the absolute best! I’ll never take my dog anywhere else!
The absolute best place friendly kind all around awesome pet care takers. This was our first time but we will keep going. Xoxox

I refuse to go anywhere else. Sally turns my dirty tomboy doodle into a glowing princess angel every single time!!! She is consistent and considerate. She shapes her so beautifully that it looks like her legs are floating off the ground and I can see my baby's gorgeous face again! I have been seeing Sally since my dog's first groom as a pup years ago, the attached pics are all from different grooms and they are always perfect. Sometimes my dog tends to get matted, even with regular brushing, and if so Sally always calls me to let me know if she has to go shorter than we discussed and tells me if I will get a matting fee - there are never any surprises. We love Sally!
They did a wonderful job with our golden retriever! Would highly recommend to anyone; very friendly, caring staff.
